contains: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A broad Sonoma County AVA covering the northern part of the county. It fully contains Alexander Valley, Russian River Valley, Dry Creek Valley and others. Its grapes include Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Zinfandel.
